b.x: This is education, not a diagnosis and not a product. It does not promise a new neuron by decree, nor that a sentence at night rebuilds the network. The depression page is another one. If the wish is to die, in Brazil dial 188. This page does not dial.

Neuroplasticity is the nervous system changing with experience. It is not a gift of the few. It is the rule. Neurons that fire together come to fire more easily. That is how a skill stops costing full attention: tying a shoe, recognizing a face, finding the exit of a building you have already walked. The connection you do not use loses priority. The brain does not store everything at the same price. It stores cheaply what repeats. Childhood is more moldable. The adult changes too, more slowly, with repetition, attention, and sleep. What science describes with more confidence in the adult is the change in the strength and the use of connections. A new lobe of the brain being born is not the promise. The path getting easier, yes.

Three things weigh. Repetition: once is chance. Many times is a path. Attention: what you do not attend barely enters the recording. That is why the practice asks for the foot, not the film. Sleep: it is at night that the day firms up. Sleeping badly leaves the learning loose and leaves the prefrontal tired the next day. Emotion also records. Threat and humiliation mark faster than a calm lesson, because the brain treats that as urgent. A room where they laughed at you can become a path for a whole life. Not because it is true. Because it was intense and it was repeated inside afterward. The same mechanism that teaches the hand to find the exit teaches fear to arrive first.

A limiting belief is a worn path. The sentence I cannot became cheap. The trigger tightens and it fires before you choose. Attention, returning to the foot, is the new path: control calling the focus back. Recognizing a stroke, boiling the water, walking the block, learning a tool, are the same law. Another use, repeated, with the body. You do not feel the connection change. You feel, later, that the film took a little longer to start, or that the hand found the gesture without rehearsal. That delay, that ease, is plasticity showing up. The bad path obeys the law too. Rehearsal of catastrophe, rumination, and repeated fear dig a groove. Plasticity does not choose your side. It obeys what you practice.

It does not turn on the same night. Weeks of dull use, not one speech. It does not replace sleep, food, or treatment when health asked for it. It does not say you caused an illness by thinking wrong. It does not say an injured brain is condemned. It says only this: what you repeat with attention gets easier, and what you drop loses force. Choose the path on purpose. One return to the foot. One gesture the sentence forbids. One skill that saves, trained before the day. The law is the same. The side is yours.
